# Hindawi — JSON view (alternative)

The primary distribution is `dist/hindawi/` — the **original Hindawi structure**:
one directory per shaili with `.uhin` transducers, Makefile and driver, plus
`hindrv/`, `keywords`, `samples/` and `exercises/`.

This directory is a machine-readable **alternative view** of the same tables for
tooling. It is not the distribution and does not replace it.
